title: Warlord Gintolaken
summary: Defeat three war chieftains to unlock Warlord Gintolaken.
overview: Defeat three war chieftains to unlock Warlord Gintolaken.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear the Rock Studded Champions, Myrmidons of Stone and Stonefist Clansmen to expose their associated chieftains.
Defeat Galronar, Awisano and Birak. Their expedition lockouts jointly unlock Gintolaken.
Gintolaken wipes hate every three minutes and has additional low-chance hate clears between those resets. Keep multiple tanks ready.
The named stages have fifty-minute hard despawns; the overall event has a three-hour failure limit.
Victory produces a planar projection for progression credit.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
